assertion_analysis.fails_if: The initial full build omits a historical row or the decode instrument misses known full payloads; row count 50 and at least 50 decodes are independent constants.
Restoring the base rebuild decodes 51 full payloads; omitting the append yields fewer than 51 returned/persisted/group rows; corrupt sample aggregation changes the independently known median of 26.
Removing the authoritative fallback restores base rows=50; failure to reach the refused-index last-good path produces a zero call count.
Removing missing/corrupt/mismatched entry fallback skips the required single full build, misses at least 51 observed full decodes or omits the new row.
Dropping future samples prematurely, retaining expired samples or miscomputing fold statistics diverges from an independent full run_time_profile read of the authoritative ledger at the same time.
Accepting rewritten/deleted/aggregate-moved history skips the single rebuild or disagrees with a subsequent full ledger-derived profile.
The fold omits the append or publishes after a generation change; removing the generation publication check changes cache bytes saved before the append.

assertion_independence: No added assertion compares output solely with a value supplied by that same output; literal counts/median, known positive decoding, full ledger rebuilds, mock call counts and pre-operation cache bytes supply independent expectations.
